tested.environment: local dev server (pnpm dev) with the seeded recipe fixture; Chrome 129; desktop 1280x800 and phone 390x844; light and dark

flow.given: the search page is showing results for "soup"
flow.when: the user clears the search box
flow.then: within 300 ms the spinner is gone and the "Type to search recipes" empty state shows
continues: show the spinner while a non-empty query is loading, then its results
show the error banner when the request fails
keep the ?q= URL parameter in step with the box

check.evidence: screenshots of the cleared state on desktop light and phone dark, plus one of a loading query, in evidence/qa/

flow.expect: all tests pass, including "clears loading when the query is emptied"

jank.item: No layout shift when the spinner hides
Empty state readable in dark theme
No stale results flash after clearing

fix_log.finding: F-1: a response that lands after the box is cleared brings old results back
fix_log.cause: the in-flight request was not aborted when the query became empty

assumed: Firefox behaves like Chrome here; the fix is in shared hook code and Firefox was only used in the sweep.
surprises: Round 1 passed, but the end review found a race (F-1) that a single clear in QA could not show; round 2 added a type-then-clear-fast check.
